ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity on September 10, 2026, repurchasing 45,410 equity shares at an average price of ₹303. This brings the cumulative total of shares bought back to 1,188,150, a material impact that reduces outstanding shares and typically aims to enhance shareholder value and Earnings Per Share. The report indicates routine compliance with SEBI regulations for an open market buyback, with no immediate red flags identified from the provided information.
